fields.account:
Fix stale dvh after mobile keyboard dismisses

Sizing body with 100dvh leaves a blank strip under the input row on
Safari and some Chromium states: after the virtual keyboard retracts,
the browser doesn't always recompute the dvh value, so the page stays
sized to "viewport minus keyboard" while the actual visible viewport is
full-height again.

Drive the body height from visualViewport.height via a CSS custom
property. visualViewport fires a resize event on every keyboard
show/hide, URL-bar show/hide, and orientation change, so the layout
tracks the actually-visible area reliably.

https://claude.ai/code/session_0162VbmbQuRzSmC4CN6Witsq

ended.reason: Merged by john as 592cf39 ('Fix mobile viewport height handling with visualViewport API'), 26 s after the commit; no PR review text in the material.
72395ae (change change-38) drives body height from visualViewport; see decision-41.

fields.says: Sizing body with 100dvh leaves a blank strip under the input row on Safari and some Chromium states: after the keyboard retracts the browser does not always recompute dvh, so the page stays sized to viewport minus keyboard.

fields.answer: Body height is driven from visualViewport.height (falling back to innerHeight) through the --app-height custom property, updated on visualViewport resize, window resize and orientationchange; CSS falls back to 100dvh, then 100%.
fields.why: dvh goes stale after the keyboard retracts; visualViewport tracks the actually-visible area (72395ae).
